text:
Maria L.: kicking off a quota walkthrough for the new edge cluster (sea-west). need to lock GPUs + network egress before we start priming. cc @Jon P. @Devan (infra)
Jon P.: thanks. what's the SKU mix we're asking for? A100s or H100s? also what's the expected steady-state vs burst?
Maria L.: target is 24 H100s persistent for Dedicated pool, plus 48 burst seats (could be lower-cost A100s) for priming and canary runs. steady state ~18 GPUs, burst for onboarding/bench ~48 for a few hours.
Devan (infra): ok. two things: 1) quota requests need explicit project + billing contact, 2) we should request a regional fallback (nearby region) in case capacity delayed. i'll request reserve windows.
alia-sre-bot: created ticket INF-Q-4782: "sea-west GPU quota & reservation request". link: https://internal.redwood/sys/tickets/INF-Q-4782
Alia K.: copying the runbook snippet i used last time for quota payloads — paste into the cloud console request form: ```json
{
  "project": "redwood-edge-sea",
  "contact_email": "infra-oncall@redwood.ai",
  "gpu_types": ["H100-80GB"],
  "count_persistent": 24,
  "count_burst": 48,
  "start_window": "2026-04-02T02:00Z",
  "end_window": "2026-04-05T02:00Z",
  "justification": "cluster bring-up + perf tuning for sea-west edge cluster"
}
```
Sam T.: note on costs — committed persistent H100s will trigger reserved pricing; if finance needs numbers, use ~ $6.2/hr per H100 as a conservative estimate for budgeting (use your region multiplier).
Jon P.: for networking: we need 10 Gbps egress cap for each host pool and a NAT gateway bandwidth reservation. can you add that to the ticket, Maria?
Maria L.: added: NAT gateway 10Gbps, VPC peering with core (redundant), subnet CIDR allocations listed in the ticket. also requested a soft hold so quota doesn't auto-allocate to other requests.
Devan (infra): validation plan — 1) bootstrap 3 control-plane nodes, 2) prime KV/cache with a small tokenized workload, 3) spin up a 4-node H100 inference staging pool and run 50k token synthetic run to confirm tail latency, 4) run failover to fallback region. i'll put the exact checklist in the ticket.
Alia K.: quick checks you can run once nodes exist: ```bash
# check GPU visibility
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gpu
ssh jump@node-01 "nvidia-smi -L"
# verify quotas via gcloud (example)
gcloud compute regions describe sea-west --project redwood-edge-sea | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'
```
Sam T.: tagging finance + product in the ticket so they see commit window. product may push rollout later; we should add a canary rollback SLO.
Jon P.: who's oncall for the bring-up weekend? i can take Friday-Sat, Devan can cover Sun-Mon. Maria to confirm handoff doc.
Maria L.: confirmed -> i'll drop the handoff doc link in the ticket. action items: 1) INF-Q-4782 open (alia-sre-bot), 2) finance notified, 3) backup region reserved (sea-north), 4) bootstrap checklist queued. assigning primary owner: Devan. :thumbsup:
alia-sre-bot: updated ticket INF-Q-4782 with attachments: runbook-checklist.md, network-cidr-plan.yaml
Devan (infra): i'll start the cloud quota escalation now and ping GCP/partner rep for a faster approval. if anyone has objections to the SKU mix speak now.
Sam T.: no objections. please include cost estimate breakdown per day in the ticket so finance can pre-approve.
Maria L.: thanks all — we'll reconvene in #eng-infra tomorrow at 10:30 PT for final sign-off.
